in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew roots 'mla' meaning honey, 'ysn' meaning sand, and 'dr' meaning sweetness or to rule.

in_greek.name: Μελισανδρα
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek roots 'meli' meaning honey and 'andros' meaning man. This name may have been given to a woman due to her sweetness or her ability to soothe and comfort.

in_latin.name: Melisandra
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin roots 'mel' meaning honey, 'is' meaning sand, and 'andros' meaning man. This name may have been given to a woman due to her sweetness or her ability to soothe and comfort.
